blocks.title: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
blocks.text: BFS explores all the nodes of a graph level by level, starting from a given root node, using a queue to keep track of the nodes still to be explored.

items: Start from the root node and enqueue it.
Dequeue a node, process it, and enqueue all its unvisited neighbours.
Repeat until the queue is empty.

blocks.text: In a social network, where nodes are people and edges are friendships, BFS can find the shortest path between two people, the degree of separation. BFS runs in O(V + E) time, where V is the number of vertices and E the number of edges.
